attack.fit: Preserve whole-body windup and low follow-through; fit club and fingers, native knee anticipation and support as needed; measure actual impact. Keep recovery, do not speed up the complete clip.

walking.fit: Retain heavy lateral weight transfer; calibrate ground contacts, stride and club carry.

running.fit: Current playbook run; source ankle paths, 1.5 m stride fit for short heavy legs, fixed club carry.

standing.fit: Crouched native ready posture, fitted club across the front.

hit.fit: Keep 0.5 s recoil within native 0.625 s.

death.fit: Forward collapse, final-pose Dead; fit actual club and broad torso contacts.

fidget.fit: Two-sided alert glance with held club; retain supported weight shift and fit the club outside the torso.

motion_rejections: MaceAttackR1/R2/R3 have short anticipation and long low holds; not selected for this heavy attack.
Standing Melee Attack Horizontal gives a sideways sweep rather than the native downward slam.
Mutant Walking has large root travel and a pronounced lurch; Orc Walk provides closer weight transfer.
